user.title: Connect to your Harvst control panel
user.description: Enter the local network address of your Harvst irrigation control panel.

data.username: Username (only if you set a device password)
data.password: Password (only if you set a device password)

reconfigure.title: Update Harvst control panel connection
reconfigure.description: Update the address or credentials for this control panel - for example if its IP address changed. This must still be the same physical panel; to add a different one, set up a new integration entry instead.

data.username: Username (only if you set a device password)
data.password: Password (only if you set a device password)

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the control panel at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The control panel rejected that username/password.

abort.already_configured: This control panel is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: That address answered with a different panel's device ID. Reconfigure only updates how to reach the same panel - set up a new integration entry to add a different one.

data_description.zone_max_runtime: Sent to the panel itself every time a zone is turned on, so the panel's own firmware enforces it - the zone will stop on its own after this many seconds even if Home Assistant goes offline, crashes, or never sends a turn-off command mid-cycle.
